01 / POSITIONING

Not an agency. Not a prompt shop. An operating partner.

The businesses we help are already operating, already serving customers, and falling behind. Leads wait too long. Client follow-up gets missed. Important work piles up because the owner and team have more to manage than their current systems can carry.

Homi & Co. works like a fractional AI-enabled back office and growth department. We map where work breaks down, identify what those gaps are costing, define what technology should and should not do, connect the right systems, and return the evidence as a clear decision brief.

The product isn’t more AI. It’s the architecture that makes AI useful inside a real business.

THE DIFFERENCE

We’re not the AI guys.

What most AI shops do

  • They sell you a chatbot or automation project and leave.
  • They demo tools.
  • They hand you prompts.
  • They sell technology.

What Homi & Co. does

  • We install an operating layer and stay to run it.
  • We map where work breaks down and price the fix on the cost of the problem.
  • We build governed systems with approvals, audit trails, and decision briefings.
  • We sell the outcome: routine work handled, you make the calls that matter.

If you want AI tools, hire an AI agency. If you want your business to run, talk to us.

Built for the work already in motion.

Homi brings the operating layer into focus without losing the craft, judgment, and relationships that make a small business worth building.

03 / HOMI OS

A portable operating layer, built around your business.

Homi OS turns a general AI environment into a governed, business-specific system. It carries company truth, assigns narrow roles, coordinates workflows, connects existing software, measures outcomes, and sends the right decisions back to leadership.

STOPRemove work that no longer creates a required outcome.
AUTOMATEUse deterministic software for stable, repeatable rules.
AI-ASSISTLet AI prepare, summarize, classify, or recommend while a person remains accountable.
HUMAN-LEDProtect work that depends on judgment, trust, nuance, consent, or relationships.

The proprietary system

More than prompts. A versioned business asset.

  1. Business DNAApproved facts, offers, customers, policies, roles, systems, and metrics.
  2. Governed agent contractsNarrow purposes, inputs, permissions, approvals, outputs, risks, and fallbacks.
  3. Reusable workflowsTriggers, state, handoffs, exception paths, approvals, and definitions of done.
  4. Knowledge baseFindable, current source material with ownership and provenance.
  5. Governance and auditRisk tiers, approval gates, action history, tenant boundaries, and safe stops.
  6. Measurement and briefingA chain from activity to behavior, conversion, outcomes, exceptions, and decisions.

05 / REQUIREMENTS

What you’ll need.

No special technical team is required. We build around the business, the tools you already use, and clear ownership.

  1. You own everything.Your accounts, your data, your policies, your reports. We work inside your systems, nothing is held hostage.
  2. An AI environment to build in.Recommended: Muse, our primary build environment. Also supported: ChatGPT.
  3. Logins to the business software you already use.Email, calendar, CRM, and the other systems involved in the work.
  4. A decision-maker who can stay involved.Someone willing to answer a short list of approvals each week and document key policies.
  5. No new hardware.No rip-and-replace of your current tools.
06 / FIT

Built for businesses that are behind, and ready to catch up.

The industry can vary. The pattern is consistent: demand exists, but manual work and disconnected systems are costing time, leads, clients, or capacity. The Blueprint is for owners who feel that cost and are ready to fix the operating problem beneath it.

A strong fit

  • An operating business already losing leads, clients, or capacity to missed work
  • An owner or team carrying more manual work than they can reliably manage
  • Repeated friction, delay, duplication, or missed follow-up
  • A decision-maker willing to document policies and approvals
  • Enough economic pain to justify solving the operating problem now

Not the right starting point

  • A pre-revenue idea with no real workflows to observe
  • An urgent request to install a tool before diagnosis
  • A buyer seeking only prompts or generic AI training
  • A request for unsupervised high-risk decisions
  • A team unwilling to provide accurate operating information
07 / FAQ

Straight answers before we start.

What is Homi & Co.?
Homi & Co. is an AI business orchestration company. We install and help run an operating layer that coordinates routine work, keeps approvals with people, and gives owners clear decision briefings.
How is this different from hiring an AI agency or consultant?
Most AI agencies deliver a tool or project. Homi & Co. maps where work breaks down, installs a governed operating system around the business, and can stay to run and improve it.
What does the Blueprint cost?
The standard Blueprint fee is $2,500. Founding members pay $1,500 for a limited time.
What do I need to have in place before we start?
You need an operating business, an AI environment such as Muse or ChatGPT, access to the software you already use, and a decision-maker who can answer weekly approvals and document key policies.
Do you replace my staff?
No. We remove or automate routine work, support the work that benefits from AI, and keep people responsible for judgment, trust, and relationships.
Who owns my data and accounts?
You do. Your accounts, data, policies, and reports stay under your ownership. We work inside your systems, and nothing is held hostage.
